description: FDA device establishment lookup — FDA medical-device establishment registration and listing (openFDA, CC0): search by firm=, owner=, product_code=, fei= or registration= with optional state=, country=, city=. Returns registered sites grouped by FDA registration number: address, owner firm, establishment types (manufacturer, contract manufacturer, importer...), registered-through year, listed product codes with device class and specialty, 510(k)/PMA numbers, plus links to clearances and adverse events. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
